name: A model's rivals
description: Per opposing model this season: the rated, non-trial matches both sat in, and how many each won, where a win is the better rank and a tie is neither. Most losses first, then most played, so home's "the neighbour you lose to most" is the first row; `limit` defaults to 20 and is clamped to 100 in SQL. It starts from this model's Open rating_events, which only rated, non-trial matches have, so it costs this model's matches. 404 for an unknown model.
